title: Clixked Totem
description: This Resource pack make your Totem look like Clixked
body: This resource pack transforms the classic Minecraft totem into a fully realized 3D model inspired by Clixked, giving players a fresh and eye‑catching upgrade to one of the game’s most iconic survival items. Instead of the flat vanilla texture, the totem now pops with depth, shape, and personality, making every clutch moment feel even more satisfying. The model is crafted to stay true to Minecraft’s style while adding a modern, polished look that stands out without feeling out of place. Whether you’re a PvP player who loves clean visuals or a survival grinder who wants their gear to feel more personal, this pack adds a subtle but meaningful layer of flair. Lightweight, compatible, and easy to drop into any world, it’s a simple upgrade that makes your totem feel truly unique.
